valuation.rationale: Official historical inputs with an explicit Onecool conservative/base equity cash-flow scenario; an opinion under this discipline, not issuer fair value. normalization_bridge.formula: (FY25 FCF + H126 FCF - H125 FCF - (FY25 SBC + H126 SBC - H125 SBC)) / Q226 diluted shares

competitive_advantage.rationale: AI伺服器訂單達609億美元、期末積壓950億美元，且伺服器、儲存與商用PC均成長，顯示企業通路、供應鏈整合與產品廣度具可驗證優勢。

structural_growth_runway.rationale: 公司把FY27營收指引上調至1,920億美元，AI伺服器全年收入指引740億美元；目前積壓訂單支持中期續航，但仍須監測AI資本支出循環。

financial_quality.rationale: Q2 CFO $2.225bn fell 13%; unadjusted FCF $0.986bn fell 47%. H1 FCF $4.104bn was nearly flat despite earnings growth. Adjusted FCF $8.149bn includes financing-receivables and leased-equipment addbacks, so it is not owner cash flow. Positive cash flow supports research qualification; working-capital conversion and financing risk remain material.

business_risk_and_governance.rationale: 公司揭露供應商集中、AI需求、競爭、資安與負債等主要風險；最新財報材料未出現足以否決候選資格的治理或持續經營事件，仍須持續監測供應鏈與AI需求集中。

circle_of_competence.rationale: 個人是否充分理解企業硬體、AI伺服器毛利與供應鏈循環，保留在正式建倉前由使用者確認；不阻擋研究排名。

valuation.rationale: Issuer EPS guidance with full investment-gain stress removal; retains recurring costs. Conservative/base cash-flow scenarios discount hardware cyclicality, financing receivables, working capital, leverage and AI concentration. This is a discipline opinion, not issuer fair value.
